notes: Timings use CPU 0 and process CPU time; parsing, file I/O, grammar loading, and slab snapshot setup are untimed.
Cold means no live dictionary owner, not cold CPU/OS caches.
Each operation has five calibrated samples per process; three paired rounds alternate process order. Reported medians are medians of process medians.
Memory uses a separate allocator-wrapped executable and requested allocation sizes, not RSS. Parser deleted before measurement; parsed trees/source/shared-library mappings excluded.
Tiny inputs are generated snippets; large inputs are real corpus files. All variants agree on node count, physical group count, and supertype membership checksum.
All measurements use points enabled, 16-slot groups, 8-byte alignment, default packing capacity. Memory also covers repack=true.
Baseline is pinned HEAD plus the preserved adaptive-width patch, isolating the grammar-wide dictionary change.
